# Drugs.com

> > Comprehensive medication information database providing FDA prescribing information, drug interactions, dosage guidelines, and pill identification for healthcare professionals and patients.

Drugs.com serves as a trusted pharmaceutical reference covering prescription medications like NSAIDs (Clinoril/sulindac), antipsychotics (Prolixin/fluphenazine), gastroparesis treatments (Metoclopramide/Reglan), and vaccines (Fluzone). The site provides detailed prescribing information, interaction checkers, dosage guides, and pill identification tools reviewed by pharmaceutical experts including Philip Thornton, DipPharm.

## Key Topics

- Prescription medications and dosage information
- NSAIDs (Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs)
- Drug interaction checking
- FDA prescribing information and labels
- Antipsychotic medications
- Cardiovascular and gastrointestinal risk profiles
- Gastroparesis treatments
- Influenza vaccines and immunization
- Pill identification by imprint
- Phenothiazine derivatives
- Sulindac and anti-inflammatory agents
- Metoclopramide formulations
- Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) guidelines
- Healthcare professional resources

## Drug Interaction Tools

- [Morphine Interactions Checker - Drugs.com](https://failover.drugs.com/drug-interactions/morphine.html): Morphine drug interaction checker: 583 known medication interactions

## Medication Guides & Patient Information

- [Metoclopramide: Uses, Dosage, Side Effects - Drugs.com](https://failover.drugs.com/mtm/metoclopramide-oral-injection.html): Metoclopramide guide: uses for gastroparesis, side effects & interactions

## Professional Prescribing Information

- [Clinoril - FDA prescribing information, side effects and uses](https://failover.drugs.com/pro/clinoril.html): FDA prescribing info for Clinoril (sulindac) NSAID: indications & dosage
- [Fluzone Northern Hemisphere: Package Insert / Prescribing Info / MOA](https://failover.drugs.com/pro/fluzone-northern-hemisphere.html): Fluzone influenza vaccine package insert for healthcare professionals

## Dosage References

- [Prolixin Dosage Guide - Drugs.com](https://failover.drugs.com/dosage/prolixin.html): Dosage guidelines for Prolixin (fluphenazine) antipsychotic medication

## Pill Identification

- [GP 150 Pill Orange Round 8mm - Pill Identifier](https://failover.drugs.com/imprints/gp-150-1636.html): Pill identifier: GP 150 imprint = Lisinopril 30mg (Sandoz)
